steps.title: Open the Today page
steps.narration: We're looking at the Today page, which gives a ten-second read of market conditions after the close. Let's start by opening it.
steps.point_out: The page shows the heading 'Today', the subtitle 'The ten-second read after the close', and a date badge in the top right.

expect.text: The ten-second read after the close

steps.title: Open the date picker
steps.narration: The top bar has a date selector button showing 'Latest'. Let's click it to see available snapshot dates.
steps.point_out: A calendar popover opens, showing August 2026 with clickable day cells.

steps.title: Jump to August 3rd
steps.narration: August 3rd, 2026 is a date we've prepared with real market data. Clicking it will load the Today page for that date.
steps.point_out: The URL changes to include 'asof=2026-08-03', and the top-bar badge turns amber showing 'Viewing as-of 2026-08-03 (historical)'.

steps.title: Read the market state badges
steps.narration: The 'Market state' card shows three key indicators. For the first time on this page, instead of placeholder text, they now display real market conditions in plain English.
steps.point_out: Three small badges appear: 'improving' next to Regime, 'improving' next to Market phase, and 'little changed' next to Breadth. None of them says 'NA'.

steps.title: Check the summary for consistency
steps.narration: Let's scroll down to the Summary card and read its opening sentence. It should agree with the Regime badge we just saw.
steps.point_out: The Summary card's first sentence reads 'Conditions are improving since the prior session (+4.7 regime-score points).' The word 'improving' matches the Regime badge.

expect.text: Conditions are improving since the prior session (+4.7 regime-score points).

steps.title: Refresh to verify the data is permanent
steps.narration: Let's refresh the page to make sure this data is permanently stored, not just a one-time display.
steps.point_out: After the refresh, the URL is still '?asof=2026-08-03' and all three badges show the exact same words as before.

expect.text: Conditions are improving since the prior session (+4.7 regime-score points).

steps.title: Return to Latest to confirm the feature is scoped
steps.narration: Let's go back to the Latest date to confirm that this new real-word rendering is scoped only to August 3rd. Other dates should still show placeholders.
steps.point_out: The three badges in the Market state card revert to 'NA', and the date badge shows 'Data as-of 2026-08-12' (the current frontier).
